notes.title: Playtest update - v0.4.9
notes.notes:
This update focuses on QoL improvement, bug fixes, and a tiny bit of new content and balancing.

[h1]New features[/h1]
[h2]Difficulty selection[/h2]
3 difficulty in addition of arenas have been added to the game. They will change the different objectives to reach.
[b]Important note:[/b] This feature is in beta and not fully implemented, notably, difficulty won't save if you leave the game, and for challenges, the active difficulty in the launch menu is selected.
Normal difficulty should be a tiny bit easier than the game was before but still keep a good challenge.

[h2]Shortcut and Arena page[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new page has been created to allow you to check your arena while you are in the shop or the passive shop : Arena, it will show you a freeze version of your current arena.
[*] Button for this Arena page and the Warehouse have been added to the shop and passive shop.
[*] In addition, new shortcuts have been added. While the R for reroll shortcut still exists. An open the Arena page, W the Warehouse and D the deck.
[*] Shortcuts are not yet visible in the settings but are already working!
[*] Reusing the shortcut allow you to leave the room
[/list]

[h2]Other objects become Temporary objects[/h2]
In order for other objects to be more easily understandable and diminish their text description, other object become temporary objects. Each being deleted from your deck when played (and does not count as a family).
[list]
[*] Text has been changed in accordance
[*] Brick is now a Temporary object as well: Starting the last difficulty with 2 bricks and bricks being added to your shop as 1-cost.
[*] The bowling pin was moved in the warehouse to the temporary object (since it's one and does not count as a Sport ball)
[/list]

[h2]Passive changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rightwing sign changed: Add 2 Christmas balls to your deck at the end of each round --> Every 7 seconds play a Christmas ball. [i]This should be more fun/interesting but has a huge flaw (so I might need to nerf it/add conditionality).[/i]
[*] 2 new passive: one for sports balls and one for temporary objects. [i]The two might be too strong, but let's try anyway![/i]
[*] Slowed the increased rotation speed passive to diminish the chance of object passing through the arena.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes and small QoL improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The pause button and other buttons stop disappearing when restarting a game.
[*] A tiny bit slower auto-clicker boss. Autoclicker now activate when you first click
[*] Bosses rotation and timer are now saved when you go into another page
[*] Fixed a bug where dying during some boss made the game crash
[*] Move saving to the start of the round and no longer after the first object is played.
[*] Fixed some arena load and saving issues
[*] Challenge Wellington save worked and only changing wind when in the room
[*] New text animation when gaining Gold, Heart or Deleter in the arena.
[*] Score and other text animation are displayed at the top of the screen if they are happening outside the screen (this was happening a lot when you were generating christmas balls)
[*] Luck medal start of round effect happened now really happened at the start of the round and not at the end of the previous round
[*] Tree sign text improved in accordance with it's working Double the value of fruits eaten --> Double the value of fruits and other objects eaten
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest update - v0.4.8
notes.notes:
This update is mainly focused on bug fixes and balancing.

[h1]Major changes[/h1]
[b]The Bowling ball[/b] effect has been changed: Instead of destroying the cherry, asteroid and ladybugs, the Bowling ball now destroys all objects below it when created.

[b]I letter[/b] now has a set of positions (cannot be set twice at the same space, but only 12 spaces, so the 13 I letter won't be created). I letter now also gives 10 points each time another object bounces of it (0.5-second cooldown).

Experimental: [b]Eyeball is now a 1 cost[/b] again and common but is deleted from your deck when played. But the eyeball cannot be in your starting deck. [i]With eyeball becoming a 5 cost, it became too rare and its passives were nearly useless. This change is experimental and might be reverted if the eyeball is not as satisfying as it should be.[/i]

[b]Big bang[/b] challenge has been changed, you now have a brick in your starting deck and two relevant passive. [i]The challenge should be more fun and "doable" since it was an impossible challenge. But still probably the hardest challenge with 33 triangles.[/i] 

Challenges are also now gated behind having unlocked the relevant arena.

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Pool is now less slippery (but still a tiny bit more slippery than other arenas)
[*] Jupiter bounces a tiny bit less (from 0.80 to 0.75)
[*] All sports balls are less floaty and a bit heavier
[*] Asteroids bounce a tiny bit less
[*] Start the game with one more life
[*] Make L rotate a bit slower
[*] Change the amount of passive the whale required to eat from 10 to 9.
[/list]
[i]Note: the game feels still too hard, but we are getting there![/i]


[h1]Bug fixes and minor changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug that made the Limit Speed sign not visually rotate
[*] I letter will appear at the right position when created with a donut
[*] Fix an issue that challenging with starting passive delete some of your deck.
[*] Multiple text clarification about what can destroy a malus (destroy everything --> other object when it cannot destroy a malus)
[*] Added some small explosion fx when a bomb, TNT, some effect of whale and bowling ball destroy some stuff.
[*] Change the passive available in the 33-triangle challenge
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest update - v0.4.6
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New content[/b][/h1]
[h2]New challenge[/h2]
Bouncy Castle is the 7th and last challenge

[h2]Passives changes[/h2]
[b]4 passives in the shop[/b][i]Let's try to have 4 passives in the shop to make the game a bit easier, this might be reverted later on, I would love your feedback on this change[/i]
[b]2 new passives[/b] Speed limit sign and Parking sign. All the passive are now available but are still subject to change. [i]Notably, I feel the game misses one good Sport Balls passive [/i]
[b]Passives reworks:[/b] 
[list]
[*] All animals stop eating fruits except the elephant and the whale --> Animals stop eating fruits (except Elephant and Whale) but give twice more points when combining
[*] Earth now gives 2 points for each asteroid destroyed → Earth now gives 3 points for each asteroid destroyed
[*] At the end of each round, 50 chance to add one Bowling Pin to your deck → At the end of each round, add one Bowling Pin to your deck
[*] When created black hole generates 99 asteroids → When created black hole generates your deck 2 times
[*] Passive of the Golf ball has been deleted and replaced by a new passive [b]Party sign[/b]
[/list]
[i]Behind all those changes, the idea is to strengthen the weaker passives.[/i]
[b]Passive name and Special shop name change[/b] Special shop is now called Passive Shop and "Passive of [Name]" are now "[Name] sign".

[h1][b]Other changes[/b][/h1]
[b]Bomb rework[/b] The bomb distance should be more precise
[b]Discord button[/b] A join the discord button has been added to the home menu
[b]Wind particle[/b] has been improved to be more visually accurate. Wind value has slightly changed as well
[b]Bill[/b] size is now bigger.
[b]Generate timer[/b] for Storage has been reduced from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds.
[b]Transform timer[/b] for Transportations has increased from 1 second to 2.5 seconds. [i](to ensure that the transform to car passive can activate when you also have the passive that count the sports balls as transportations)[/i]

notes.title: Playtest update - v0.4.5
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New content[/b][/h2]
[h3]Transportations rework[/h3]
[i]Comment: Transportation wasn't quite landing where it needed to be, being way too easy. While still keeping the fun of transportation it should be more balance toward the rest of the family while having an even stronger synergy with Sports balls.[/i]
The transportation order of the object has been changed. The bus is now the 1-cost instead of the Bike. The new order is : Car > Bus > Tram > Metro > Bike > Train.
The number requirement is now multiple of 4 instead of 3 (4/8/16/32/64) but now the smaller objects are at the end of the evolution. Size of objects has been redesign accordingly.

The passive between Sports Balls and Transportations has been reverted to counting all transportations.
And a new passive has been added to the pool: All the Sports Balls First wall effects are replaced by "First Wall: Create a car" (Except for the Bowling ball)

[h3]New passive[/h3]
In addition to the new transportation passive.
A new passive has been added:
Passive of the bridge: Deleting a strange letter will reimburse the deleted
Additionally two other passive have been added to the warehouse but are not yet implemented and playable.

[h3]Bosses[/h3]
The two missing bosses have been added to the game! The ?!$#! boss is probably way too hard and needs balancing. All bosses are in v1 anyway and need improvement.

[h2][b]Passive changes[/b][/h2]
Comment from Steve: Some of the passives were not that fun to play or too bad. With this rework, the main idea is to have fruits a bit easier to play with a more combo-friendly passive (Passive of the sea) and globally make both Celestials and Fruits a bit easier to play

Old effect: Every Celestial generates 1-4 Asteroids when created
New effect: Every Celestial gives twice more points when combining but generates 1-4 Asteroids when created

[b]Passive of the Christmas ball:[/b]
Old effect: Chrismas ball now gives as many points as the number of Christmas balls
New effect: Chrismas ball gives crazier points (-35 to +50)

[b]Passive of the debris:[/b]
Old effect: Every Celestial generates 1-4 Asteroids when created
New effect: Every Celestial gives twice more points when combining but generates 1-4 Asteroids when created

[b]Passive of the asteroid:[/b]
Old effect: When created, Black Hole generates 50 asteroids
New effect: When created, Black Hole generates 99 asteroids

[b]Passive of the traffic light[/b]
Old effect: Deleters give incremental points
New effect: Wheels can now be destroyed for 3 deleters

[b]Passive of the sea:[/b]
Old effect: When a Whale is created, generate one of each fruit
New effect: When an animal eats a fruit, generates either a cherry, a strawberry, a grape or an apple
Comment from Steve: Passive of the sea + passive of the Snake = FUN

[h2][b]Multiple saves
[/b][/h2]The game now has 3 save slots, by default (and your old save) is Save A but you can change save in the settings.
Also, there is a confirmation button if you want to delete your active save

[b]Balancing:[/b][list]
In addition to the passive changes, the idea has been to make both celestials and fruits easier.
[*] Jupiter is 10% less bouncy
[*] The moon now generates 1-4 instead of 1-5 asteroids.
[*] Eyeballs are now more rare and are a 5-cost unit
[*] Starting deck will now be 2 different 1-cost and 1 3-cost (instead of 4 random 1-cost and 1 3-cost)
[/list]

[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Transportations now transform the correct number of objects and not all objects.
[*] Arrow now work correctly with transportation
[*] If you lost too early in the tutorial, you could not unlock the Tutorial medal.
[*] Fullscreen now correctly save between sessions and the default version is fullscreen.
[*] Surprisingly, playing a passive was deleting a random object from your deck. Comment from Steve: I am shocked nobody (including myself) notices
[*] The heart passive no longer deletes random objects from your deck when the heart combines
[*] I identified and removed a cause of latency. The game should be smoother, if you still have some performance issues, please report them on the forum or discord
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest update - v0.4.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Major changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]6 challenges[/b] has entered the battlefield! Unlock them with a new medal, each offering a new take and challenge to the base experience! (Not available in the demo)
[*] [b]Stats everywhere:[/b] For each arena and each challenge two new stats have appeared, best score and number of wins! For each object two stats will appear in the warehouse: the number of times created and the number of times they fall into the lava! (Stats are not retroactive)
[*] [b]Coin and Bike wheel[/b] visuals!
[/list]

[h2]Minor changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cherry now has a longer tail so people stop calling it an apple!
[*] Credits were moved to settings to accommodate the new Challenge button
[*] Medals wording has been changed from "Challenge" to "Quest" to avoid confusion with challenges
[*] Passives are now re-added to the pool of passives when they fall into lava (and so can be rebought). They also correctly saved.
[*] Boss for Mountain Arena is more comfortable to play and less abrupt.
[*] Visual improvement on Gold Recap and Special Shop to give the Special Shop a more unique identity
[*] Fixed an issue with a visual effect on the background on some pages, now all the pages have a harmonized similar visual effect
[*] Replay at the end of the game lets you select the arena (except in challenges, it enables you to replay the challenge)
[*] Victory or Game Over is now written on the end screen
[*] Objective tooltip indicates more clearly which round has special shops
[*] Tooltip on the ship to indicate to go in the deck for information
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest update - v0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Balancing:[/b]
- Fruits, Animals, Sports balls and Strange Letter give more points
- Point harmonization between family (fruits and strange letters give the same amount, sports balls and celestials the same), a better curve for Storage and Transportation.
- Eyeball is now a rare object (3 cost).
- Watermelon gives 2 hearts.
- Transportations x Sports ball passive nerf to Golf and billard count in the number of Transportation
- Fruits are worth a bit more when eating them (especially small fruits)
- Black hole value changed: 1/3/5/10/40/100/500 to 1/3/5/10/50/150/500
- Deleting all objects now gives red wheels that can combine with bike wheels
- Lucky passive rework to give object at the start of every round, can also now give eyeballs

[b]Features:[/b]
- Whale effects reworked: The whale now has 7 different effects with some fun ones (eating gold for gold, eating heart for life, eating a bomb to transform the whale into a big bomb, eating passive for a unique secret game-breaker passive)
- Chrismas ball rework: Now give 2-10 points randomly
- Tooltips now can't go off-screen and have been fully reworked to have other objects in Bold and be more consistent. Fruits have which animal eats then written in their tooltip. The whale effect is written in the warehouse during a game.

[b]Small features:[/b]
- Added an arrow in the tutorial to indicate where to hover
- Hover time before display tooltip slightly increase
- Heart goes into a counter when you have more than 9 heart

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- Ensure that you always only delete one object when you sell or delete an object, also add a small delay before being authorized to delete an object in the shop
- Fix some saving/loading bugs
- The ship is now above the UI elements
